a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 8-cell plan gives us both only about a 4% chance of surviving. So I plan to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If we both survive round 1, I'll operate every round after that so you can reach 4 too. If you'd rather propose a different split, tell me.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4 this round. If there's no storm, I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill and you can take 4. I won't take any more cells.
